input.summary: Expand TrueLink's indemnity in Section 12.b to cover third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Interface and services, TrueLink's violation of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client data, and TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and add a standard indemnity procedure.
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently covers only its own breach of the Agreement, so we would carry the risk of third-party claims that the Interface or hosted services infringe IP rights, while our own indemnity is very broad. We added IP infringement, violation of law, TrueLink-caused data compromise and gross negligence/willful misconduct, plus a standard notice-and-control procedure; if TrueLink prefers, we can accept the IP indemnity with customary exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other software, materials or deliverables provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of any third party; (iii) any violation by TrueLink of any state or federal law, rule or regulation; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Credit Data or Client Proprietary Information caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

ops.text: c. Indemnity Procedure. The party seeking indemnification shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim (provided that any delay in notice shall not relieve the indemnifying party except to the extent it is materially prejudiced), shall permit the indemnifying party to control the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on the indemnified party may be entered into without its prior written consent), and shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. The indemnified party may participate in the defense with counsel of its own choosing at its own expense.
